jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Information**

* **Title:** Implementation Specialist
* **Type:** Full Time
* **Location:** Hybrid / Remote (New Haven, CT Preferred)
* **Compensation Range:** $65,000 \- $95,000
* **Sponsorship:** No

**About Veoci** 

*Veoci Inc. is a SaaS company that develops and sells solutions for Emergency Management and Business Continuity Planning, as well as specialized software. Through rapid development, depth of knowledge, innovative thinking, and commitment to diversity, we help save time, money, and lives.* 

*Veoci’s platform is designed for developing applications, from simple approval forms, to coordinated response plans, to highly complex continuity management programs –anything is possible with Veoci. We offer the most straightforward, easy to use platform for you and your teams, and we know what it takes to ensure your applications never stop running.* 

*Veoci, a leader in collaboration, continuity, and response software, is a dynamic and growing company committed to providing exceptional service to our clients. We pride ourselves on fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where every employee can thrive and contribute to our success.*

**Position Summary**

As Veoci continues to expand, we are seeking a talented Implementation Specialist to join our team and support our customers throughout implementation of the Veoci software.

As an Implementation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the successful and timely implementation of our customers’ contracted services. This role ensures that customers have an experience that will lead to high customer usage and renewal of services. Ideal candidates will be passionate about managing projects, working closely with the solutions team, and providing outstanding service to our customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support multiple implementation projects that vary in length and complexity from inception through completion, ensuring that timelines and deliverables are met.
* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation process, managing client expectations to ensure their needs are met and they have an overall positive experience with Veoci.
* Create and maintain detailed implementation plans, including but not limited to milestones, resource allocation, deliverables, tasks, and risk management strategies associated with the process, and any other project documentation requested by a customer (e.g. project plans).
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure solutions are configured to client specifications.
* Identify, diagnose, and resolve or escalate technical issues that arise during the implementation process both internally and externally.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their motivations, expectations, and role in the process.
* Provide technical support during the pre\-sales process, including onboarding presentations and feasibility assessments for customer kick off meetings.
* Provide regular reports to management on ongoing implementations.
* Maintain thorough documentation of the implementation process for each customer, including client communications, configuration settings, integration details, and client\-specific customizations as required.
* Collaborate with Product Management to standardize and improve implementation plans and best practices to drive user adoption and enable excellent onboarding for customers.
* Ensure a smooth transition from the implementation phase to the support phase, providing clients with the necessary documentation and resources.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in implementing software for external customers, preferably in a client\-facing or project management capacity.

**Preferred Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences and facilitate effective client\-facing and internal meetings.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong understanding of software implementation, data migration, and system configuration, with the ability to quickly learn and master new software systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes, anticipate challenges, and determine when issues should be resolved independently or escalated.
* Nice to have: Project management certification or formal project management training, and experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Monday.com, or Microsoft Project.

**Physical Requirements \& Compensation**

Veoci offers remote work flexibility, with this role having the option to be remote or hybrid, with a strong preference for the candidate to be onsite 4 days a week in our New Haven, CT office. This role may require travel a few times a year for team/company meetings.

The wage range for this role is $65,000 \- $95,000 plus benefits.Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

**Benefits**

One of our core priorities at Veoci is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy.

* Work with a world\-class software team that will help you achieve your best work and be at the leading edge with AI
* Boundaryless interaction with a proven leadership team that will challenge you
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and access to additional medical services
* Company contribution to 401k
* Paid time off, including parental leave and a competitive PTO package
* Company commitment to workplace flexibility and a positive and inclusive environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

*Veoci is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Veoci will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

*This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Veoci has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.*

*Veoci uses automated and AI\-assisted tools as part of its applicant screening and resume review process. These tools may analyze application materials to assist our HR team in evaluating candidate qualifications. Veoci does not make final employment decisions solely on the basis of automated processing — all hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified HR professionals and hiring managers.*

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Will you require sponsorship now or in the future?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Software implementation: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Haven, CT 06510

jobs.title: Administrative Support Specialist for Onboarding Department
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Administrative Support Specialist** to support onboarding and offboarding processes for travel advisors within our agency. This position plays a critical role in ensuring smooth transitions when advisors join or leave the organization, as well as providing support and coverage for members of our Onboarding Department.

  

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across multiple software systems, is proficient with Microsoft Office, communicates professionally via Outlook email, and thrives in an independent work environment. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills are essential.

 **Key Responsibilities**



Onboarding \& Offboarding Support


* Coordinate onboarding tasks for new travel advisors across multiple internal systems and supplier platforms
* Process offboarding tasks, ensuring timely removal of access and proper documentation
* Create and remove user logins across various systems and supplier websites
* Track and maintain onboarding/offboarding checklists to ensure accuracy and completion
* Cross\-train in selected operational functions to provide backup support to other team members as needed.
* Auditing and updating information for advisors across systems


Documentation \& Compliance


* Contact advisors to collect required documentation, including contracts, professional insurance paperwork, and HR\-related information
* Maintain organized digital records and ensure documentation is complete and properly filed
* Follow established procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements to make information easier for advisors and staff to understand and access


Communication \& Customer Service


* Communicate clearly and professionally with advisors and internal teams via Outlook email and in person
* Provide timely follow\-up and excellent customer service throughout onboarding and offboarding processes
* Serve as a helpful resource for advisors navigating administrative requirements and new software systems


Administrative \& Office Support


* Assist with general administrative tasks and provide backup coverage for other operational roles as needed
* Organize and coordinate luncheons and small in\-office events
* Support ongoing operational projects and special assignments

  


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of administrative, operations, or support experience (travel industry experience preferred but not required)
* Process\-driven with exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong professional communication skills, particularly in Outlook email correspondence
* Excellent customer service and follow\-up skills
* Comfortable learning new technology and processes within multiple software systems
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Familiarity with Dropbox, Monday.com, and AirTable is helpful but not required
* Patient, approachable, and service\-oriented, with the ability to work effectively with individuals who have varying levels of technical experience.
* Strong time management skills and ability to determine priorities to meet deadlines

  


**Work Environment**



This is a **hybrid position based in Raleigh, NC, requiring in\-office days with the ability to work from home on Tuesdays and Thursdays**. During weeks when no in\-person training is scheduled of advisors new to our agency, employees may work remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays, subject to business needs. Additional in\-office attendance may occasionally be required for meetings, staff training, or company events.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Reports to:** Senior Director, Solution Delivery


**Location:** Remote, Must be located in Eastern Time zone


At PTC, we embrace the power of transformation. Together, we make an impact across industries by enabling companies to bring products to market faster, improve quality, and increase innovation.


Arena, a PTC business, provides industry\-leading cloud\-native Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Quality Management System (QMS) solutions that help companies accelerate product development while maintaining compliance and operational excellence.


As Arena continues to grow, our customers are implementing increasingly sophisticated solutions that span product development, quality management, analytics, supply chain collaboration, automation, and enterprise integrations. To help customers realize value faster, we are investing in a dedicated implementation management capability focused on project governance, customer accountability, and implementation excellence.


**Overview**

The Senior Implementation Program Manager is responsible for leading complex customer onboarding and implementation programs for Arena PLM and QMS. This role serves as the primary owner of implementation execution, customer accountability, project governance, risk management, executive communication, and delivery forecasting.


Working closely with Solution Architects, Customer Success Coaches, Technical Consultants, Account Managers, and customer stakeholders, the Senior Implementation Program Manager ensures projects remain on schedule, risks are proactively managed, and customers are prepared to make timely decisions throughout the onboarding journey.


The ideal candidate combines enterprise SaaS implementation experience, outstanding customer\-facing skills, strong executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across both customer and internal teams.


This role is responsible for implementation success but is not responsible for solution design, configuration, training delivery, or technical implementation activities.


**Senior Implementation Program Manager Duties**

* Own and drive the successful execution of strategic customer implementations by developing and managing project plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure alignment with defined success criteria while coordinating activities across customer and internal teams to maintain momentum throughout the implementation lifecycle. Lead and manage multiple projects to ensure the realization of value, quality, and on\-time delivery of the defined scope
* Establish clear customer responsibilities, milestones, and expectations. Drive customer accountability for commitments, timelines, and deliverables, and proactively identify and escalate risks that could impact implementation success
* Establish a structured executive communication framework that promotes transparency, accountability, and informed decision\-making throughout the implementation lifecycle. Deliver concise status updates, facilitate governance discussions, and cultivate strong relationships with customer leadership to drive project success
* Own the ongoing refinement of the standardized project schedules, reporting frameworks, and governance templates that promote consistency across implementations. Continuously assess delivery performance and recommend process enhancements that improve predictability, resource utilization, and implementation outcomes
* Develop and strengthen project management capabilities within Solution Delivery by coaching team members, sharing best practices, and building leadership skills across the organization. Drive the establishment of a scalable PMO framework that supports growth, operational maturity, and successful customer outcomes
* Jointly work with partners and support partner projects as needed
Operates and participates in customer steering committees  
* 

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in program/project implementation management leadership
* Proven track record of managing enterprise\-level transformation programs
* Exceptional customer written and verbal communication, executive engagement, and stakeholder management skills
* Accustomed to preparing for and leading steering committee meetings
* Navigate difficult implementation discussions with confidence and professionalism
* Lead full project lifecycles leveraging either traditional PMI Process or Scrum/Agile approach
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects
* Bachelor’s degree required

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of and experience with industry\-specific processes with High\-tech Electronics, Medical Device, and/or Aerospace \& Defense manufacturers
* Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and/or Quality Management System (QMS) system experience
* Expertise using Smartsheet
* Experience with Cloud\-based, Software as a Service offerings
* PMP or PgMP certification or equivalent is highly desirable

**This position is not eligible for employment\-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC.**  

  



PTC carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation. The anticipated annual salary range for this position is between $144,650 \- $187,000 The anticipated annual salary range encompasses both the base salary and the on\-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role. The salary range reflects a good\-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting .


Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Eligible e mployees also have the opportunity to become a PTC shareholder through our employee share purchase program (ESPP) which allows for the purchase of discounted PTC stock . All total rewards and benefits programs are subject to plan eligibility and other terms and conditions.


For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits, please visit our Careers Page .

jobs.title: Client Implementation & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the role:**


The Client Training Specialist is responsible for delivering high\-quality, role\-based training programs to new and existing clients across all product lines, including EMR, Practice Management (PM), ASC, iOptical, and Patient Engagement solutions. This role focuses exclusively on training delivery and client education through a combination of onsite sessions (10–20% travel), live remote webinars, and structured re\-training programs. The Specialist ensures end\-user readiness, drives system adoption, and supports ongoing client success through continuous education and optimization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Skills and qualifications (mandatory):**

**Training Delivery (Onsite \& Remote)** 

* Deliver comprehensive, role\-based training for all system modules including EMR, PM, ASC, iOptical, and Patient Engagement.
* Conduct onsite training sessions at client locations (10–20% travel), including go\-live readiness and support.
* Facilitate live remote training sessions via webinars for individuals and groups.
* Execute hybrid training programs that combine onsite and virtual learning.
* Tailor training sessions to align with client workflows, specialties, and user roles (providers, clinical staff, front desk, billing teams, etc.).
* Ensure all training sessions are engaging, effective, and aligned to adult learning best practices.

 **New Client Training Programs**

* Partner with Project Management teams to deliver training aligned with project timelines.
* Execute structured training plans to prepare clients for go\-live.
* Track training completion and user readiness; escalate risks related to incomplete training.
* Partner with Project Management to provide recommendations on training approach based on client size, complexity, and product mix.

 **Client Re\-Training \& Ongoing Education**

* Deliver re\-training sessions for existing clients, both onsite and via live remote webinars.
* Conduct targeted training to address workflow gaps, low adoption, or staff turnover.
* Lead optimization\-focused training sessions to improve efficiency and system utilization.
* Provide ongoing education on new features, system updates, and best practices.

 **Training Content Development \& Maintenance**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve training materials, including:


o Training guides


o Job aids


o Recorded webinars


o Quick reference materials

* Update training curriculum based on product releases, client feedback, and evolving


workflows.

* Contribute to scalable training assets for broader client use (e.g., recorded sessions,


knowledge base content).

 **Client Experience \& Enablement**

* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring a positive and effective training experience.
* Build strong relationships with end users and practice leadership.
* Gather and document client feedback to improve training programs and materials.
* Reinforce best practices and standardized workflows across all training engagements.

 **Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Product, Support, and Implementation teams to stay current on system updates and enhancements.
* Provide feedback on product usability and training gaps based on client interactions.
* Participate in internal training sessions and ongoing professional development.
* Maintain expertise across all product modules and workflows.

 **Skills and qualifications (mandatory):**

* Proven experience delivering software training, both onsite and via live remote/webinar formats.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
* Experience training adult learners with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple training engagements simultaneously.
* Strong customer service mindset with a focus on client success and adoption.

**Skills and qualifications (preferred):**

* Experience with healthcare technology such as EMR/EHR, Practice Management, ASC systems, Optical software, or Patient Engagement platforms.
* Background in ambulatory care, ophthalmology, or clinical/operational healthcare settings.
* Experience developing training materials, curricula, and eLearning content.
* Familiarity with webinar platforms and learning management systems (LMS).
* Experience supporting user adoption and workflow optimization initiatives.
* Technical aptitude with SaaS platforms and ability to quickly learn new systems.

 **Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 10–20% for onsite client training and go\-live support.

 **EEO Disclaimer:***SIGHTVIEW SOFTWARE LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to age, color, race, religion, sex, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, national origin, sexual orientation,* *veteran, or disability status,* *or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. Benefits/Perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the country where you work.*

jobs.title: EMR Support Specialist On-Site
jobs.description:
\*\*ON\-SITE (NOT REMOTE)\*\*  

  

**Department:**  

Health Information Management

  

**Schedule/Status:**
8:00am\-4:30pm; Full Time

  

**Standard Hours/Week:**
40

  

**General Description:**
The Electronic Medical Record (EMR) Support Specialist reports to the HIM Operations Manager. The EMR Support Specialist ensures the integrity of the EMR; functions as the super\-user for HIM applications as designated; monitors the quality and accuracy of scanned documents; audits medical records for proper form usage; and communicates results to the appropriate parties. The EMR Support Specialist is responsible for compiling, organizing, interpreting and reporting data from multiple sources to various stakeholders; coordinating the forms management program for the system; and supporting various projects related to HIM applications, EMR workflows, coding, and reimbursement. The position shall exemplify the desired Culture of Choice® and philosophies of Parrish Healthcare.  

 **Key Responsibilities:**
* Performs with accuracy day\-to\-day tasks to support the HIM department including but not limited to creating reports, validating data, compiling data for analysis, and presenting information for decision making.
* Designs, creates, and identifies tools to determine the current state of the Unbilled, HIM performance tracking, quality tracking, and HIM productivity metrics.
* Provides support to HIM and other departments by compiling requested charts for external review and reporting of quality measures.
* Formats, barcodes, and uploads all clinical forms into the form’s repository. Coordinates the Forms Management program, responsible for keeping all forms up to date, cataloged, and in compliance with The Joint Commission and hospital standards. Manages content of forms repository, which includes troubleshooting of any FormFast related technical issues, and contacting vendor if needed.
* Performs quality assurance of scanned documents to assess accuracy and tracks errors, providing feedback to the HIM Operations Manager.
* Performs routine audits of medical records and clinical units for proper form usage and inventory for the system.
* Facilitates the approval processes for forms and order sets using the appropriate virtual committees.
* Serves as the HIM contact for medical record merges and account cleanup issues.
* Supports the adoption and implementation of department applications including but not limited to the EMR, HIM applications, coding and CDI applications, and clinical applications; participates on planning and validating workgroups. Cross\-trains and functions as a backup to help other areas of HIM Operations as needed.
* Performs similar or related duties as assigned.
* Knows fire, disaster and safety procedures and regulations as it pertains to the work area.

**Requirements:**  

  

**Formal Education:**
* Bachelors degree required. Degree/Major preferred: HIM, Information Technology/Systems, Informatics, or related healthcare technology field.


**Work Experience:**
* 2\-3 years of healthcare data analysis, decision support, report writing, or related HIM/IT experience required. At least one\-year experience in a hospital HIM department strongly preferred.


**Required Licenses, Certifications, Registrations:**
* Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or other AHIMA credentials preferred or job\-related certificate approved by Human Resources and Health Information Management.


**Full Time Benefits:**
Eligible to participate in a number of PMC\-sponsored benefits, including:
* Benefits Start on Day 1
* Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
* 403(b) Retirement Program
* Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
* EAP, Flex Spending, Accident, Critical and Other Applicable Benefits
* Annual Accrual of 152 Personal Leave Bank (PLB) Hours

jobs.title: EHR Systems Analyst & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Damien Center \| Health Operations \| Indianapolis, IN
  
  

Full\-Time \| Salaried, Exempt \| $70,000
  
  

Are you the person everyone calls when eClinicalWorks won't cooperate? Do you get a little thrill out of turning a clunky workflow into one that just makes sense? And do you want your tech expertise to directly support care for people living with or at risk for HIV?
  
  

If so, we'd love to meet you. Damien Center is looking for an EHR Systems Analyst \& Support Specialist to be the go\-to expert who keeps our electronic health record running smoothly, helps our teams get the most out of it, and makes sure it works as hard for our patients as our people do.
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

Every appointment, care plan, and follow\-up at Damien Center runs through our EHR. When the system works well, our care teams can spend less time clicking and more time connecting with the people they serve. That's where you come in.
  
  

In this role, you'll be both a trusted helpdesk resource and a strategic partner. You'll troubleshoot day\-to\-day issues, yes, but you'll also shape how our integrated care, quality, and operations teams work, making sure our system supports the reporting and standards that come with being a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and a Patient\-Centered Medical Home (PCMH). Your work will have a real, visible impact on patient care.
  
  

About Damien Center
  
  

Founded in 1987, Damien Center is Indiana's oldest and largest AIDS service organization, serving more than 8,000 individuals living with or at risk for HIV. We're a trusted partner offering care coordination, integrated care and pharmacy services, mental health, housing, and nutrition, and we're a safe, welcoming home for anyone seeking care.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

Keep Our EHR Running Smoothly
  
  

•
  
Serve as the primary helpdesk resource for eClinicalWorks, troubleshooting issues and resolving user concerns
  
  

•
  
Triage, document, and track support requests through to resolution, and escalate to the vendor when needed
  
  

•
  
Manage user accounts, security roles, and access
  
  

•
  
Configure and maintain templates, forms, order sets, alerts, registries, and other workflow tools
  
  

•
  
Help test and roll out software updates and new functionality
  
  

Be Our FQHC \& PCMH Go\-To
  
  

•
  
Act as the organization's expert on how FQHC and PCMH requirements show up in EHR workflows and documentation
  
  

•
  
Make sure eClinicalWorks supports UDS reporting, quality measures, care coordination, preventive and population health, health equity, patient engagement, enabling services, and care gap management
  
  

•
  
Keep an eye on regulatory changes and recommend system updates to stay ahead of them
  
  

Drive Quality \& Continuous Improvement
  
  

•
  
Oversee maintenance of reporting tools and support UDS and quality reporting
  
  

•
  
Spot trends in support requests and turn them into smarter processes
  
  

•
  
Identify opportunities to optimize workflows and participate in quality improvement initiatives
  
  

Teach, Coach \& Empower
  
  

•
  
Develop and deliver eClinicalWorks training, from group sessions to one\-on\-one coaching
  
  

•
  
Lead EHR onboarding for new team members
  
  

•
  
Oversee educational materials and help build standard operating procedures
  
  

Collaborate \& Lead Projects
  
  

•
  
Partner with integrated care, operations, quality, and leadership teams on workflow enhancements
  
  

•
  
Serve as the liaison between end users and the EHR vendor
  
  

•
  
Participate in system implementations, upgrades, testing, and validation
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

Required
  
  

•
  
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Information Technology, Nursing, Public Health, or a related field\*
  
  

•
  
3\+ years of experience supporting an EHR system in a healthcare setting
  
  

•
  
Hands\-on experience with eClinicalWorks
  
  

•
  
2\+ years of experience in an FQHC, community health center, or primary care environment
  
  

•
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reporting tools, and healthcare technology systems
  
  

Preferred
  
  

•
  
Experience with PCMH principles and requirements
  
  

•
  
Experience with quality reporting, UDS measures, and population health initiatives
  
  

* Work or lived experience may substitute for education requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Who You Are
  
  

•
  
The Translator. You speak both "clinic" and "tech" fluently, and you can explain a system change to a provider, a front desk team member, or a leader in a way that clicks for each of them.
  
  

•
  
The Problem Solver. You enjoy digging into the "why" behind an issue and don't stop at the quick fix when a better solution is within reach.
  
  

•
  
The Patient Teacher. You're comfortable supporting people at every level of tech confidence, and you meet them where they are.
  
  

•
  
The Systems Thinker. You see how one workflow connects to reporting, quality, and ultimately patient care, and you design with the big picture in mind.
  
  

•
  
The Steady Hand. You juggle multiple priorities with organization and calm, work well independently, and handle sensitive information with the highest integrity and confidentiality.
  
  

•
  
The Relationship Builder. You build trust across departments and help create a culture of courtesy, respect, and inclusion.
  
  

Compensation \& Benefits
  
  

**Salary:** $70,000 plus an annual performance\-based salary increase
  
  

•
  
150 hours of PTO in your first year, growing to 195 hours per year after that
  
  

•
  
12 paid holidays
  
  

•
  
Medical coverage with PPO or HDHP options, plus dental and vision
  
  

•
  
HSA or FSA, plus a Dependent Care FSA
  
  

•
  
403(b) retirement plan with 5% match and 100% vesting after 90 days
  
  

•
  
Life insurance at 2x annual salary, plus voluntary life coverage for spouse and children
  
  

•
  
Short\- and long\-term disability
  
  

•
  
Employee Assistance Program and a premium Calm app subscription
  
  

•
  
Tuition assistance and professional development opportunities
  
  

Good to Know
  
  

•
  
This role reports to the Director of IT.
  
  

•
  
This is an office\-based role; remote work may be approved on a case\-by\-case basis.
  
  

•
  
Within your first 90 days, you'll complete four short healthcare IT courses (on us, with certificates provided) covering IT support in healthcare, health IT fundamentals, patient safety, and data security and privacy.
  
  

•
  
As a condition of employment, Damien Center requires an annual flu vaccination and TB test (or chest x\-ray), barring an approved religious or medical exemption.
  
  

Ready to Make an Impact?
  
  

If you're excited about using your EHR expertise to help a mission\-driven team deliver outstanding care, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior EHR Support Analyst
jobs.description:
At Virginia Garcia Memorial Health Center, we honor all members of our community and acknowledge the dignity of each person we serve. Our purpose is to provide high quality, comprehensive primary health care to the communities of Washington and Yamhill counties with a special emphasis on migrant and seasonal farm workers and a view to removing barriers to health care. We strive to provide an environment that welcomes and values the people we employ and serve.


If you are unsure whether you meet all the required qualifications for this role but are interested and passionate about this potential position, we encourage you to apply.


Job Summary: The Senior EHR Support Analyst plans, analyzes, modifies, and optimizes Epic EHR as it relates to EpicCare, Wisdom, and Willow applications. The Senior EHR Support Analyst serves as the initial point of contact to support the EHR Support Analysts. In addition to the responsibilities listed below, this position is responsible for mentoring and providing technical support for more junior support team members and training newly hired EHR Support Analysts. This role assists with the evaluation and implementation of work transitioning to the Service Desk.
  

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Delivers prompt end\-user customer support to VGMHC employees.
* Provides first and second level support to resolve problems with products and applications.
* Resolves complex problems and provides support to other EHR Support Analysts.
* Spearheads and executes process improvement projects to optimize operational efficiency.
* Fosters key stakeholder relationships, both internally and externally.
* Collaborates with other project managers, maintaining open lines of communication to ensure project success and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Conducts testing of new software implementations, upgrades, and fixes.
* Assumes ownership and accountability for the submission, monitoring, and tracking of Epic items using the JIRA reporting system and an internal Help Desk and Reporting system.
* Assists with efforts to analyze and prioritize incoming Solar Winds (Samanage) requests and alerts and help distribute as needed.
* Provides on\-site elbow support during the implementation of new software applications and system upgrades at each VG site, focusing on the Epic system.
* Collaborates closely with VG's training team to design and implement comprehensive training programs that enable users to leverage new functionality and upgrade rollouts effectively.
* Undertakes project management responsibilities for medium to large projects or sub\-projects.
* Develops comprehensive workflow maps (Visio) and training documentation that accurately captures and articulates changes.
* Conducts feasibility studies on office automation, including workflow analysis, space design considerations, and cost analysis to support informed decision\-making and improve operational efficiencies.
* Cultivates a collaborative and proactive approach with clinic leadership and users to identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, clinical practice support, and improved health outcomes.
* Employs advanced problem\-solving skills and industry knowledge to improve clinic operations and enhance patient care delivery.
* Escalates complex issues through appropriate leadership levels while ensuring effective communication with stakeholders.
* Monitors and tracks resolution of system error pools, such as refill, E\-prescribing, results, and order transmittal errors.
* Updates and maintains member\-managed system setups, including the provider master file, letter templates, Smart Phrases, and other service area files.
* Collaborates with staff to support service area preference lists and Smart Tools to troubleshoot and address user needs.
* Maintains partnership with OCHIN and advisory workgroups support effective implementation of new features and upgrades and to ensure successful adoption and utilization of enhanced functionalities.
* Participates in monthly OCHIN meetings to share best practices and updates.
* Represents EHR in workgroups, including Integration, Claims/Billing, Reporting, Clinical, and Operations.
* Conducts thorough evaluations of software solutions and recommends improvements or upgrades and reports findings to EHR Support Supervisor.
* Takes ownership of creating and maintaining Provider Epic user accounts, Provider Master Files (PMFs), Remote Access, LabCorp Link, Haiku/Canto, and Nuance Dragon Speak.
* Collaborates with VG Communications team to develop, schedule, and deploy CareMessage patient text message outreach.
* Assumes responsibility for creating and maintaining CareMessage user accounts.
* Works with OCHIN and VG Communications team to maintain and update VG MyChart website and application.
* Maintain updated Order Transmittal destination maps as needed.
* Reviews OCHIN alerts or notifications and service/enhancement packs and disseminates information to end users promptly.
* Maintains current knowledge of advancements and best practices in EHR systems, healthcare technology, and regulatory requirements. Participate in conferences, webinars, and advanced training sessions to continuously enhance knowledge and skills related to EHR support, showcasing a relentless pursuit of professional growth and excellence.
* Trains newly hired EHR Support Analysts.
* Follows procedures for incident escalation and notification to EHR Support Supervisor
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.
* Handle protected health information (PHI) in a manner consistent with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).

  

HIPAA Requirements:
  

The EHR Support Analyst will have access to PHI in the course of his/her duties. Applying the minimum necessary standard of HIPAA, the designated record sets to which this employee will have access include: all sections of the medical record, patient demographic information in the practice management system, and incoming records, reports, results, consultations, etc. The EHR Site Specialist is required to read the content of these records only to the extent needed to accomplish the assigned task.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required:
  

* Ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in a clinical or EHR setting.
* Knowledge of training and teaching strategies, methodologies, and basic instructional concepts.
* Ability to perform effective one\-on\-one and group training.
* Extensive knowledge of EPIC system (EHR and EDR).
* Knowledge of basic medical terminology preferred.
* Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to demonstrate these skills.
* Excellent Customer Service skills.
* Planning and organizational skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
* Ability to make independent decisions based on VGMHC policies and protocols.
* Bilingual English/Spanish language skills (speaking, reading, and writing) preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment and alignment to Virginia Garcia’s mission, vision, and values.
* Valid Oregon driver’s license, reliable transportation, safe driving record, and insurance coverage required.

  

Education and Experience:
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required.
* Minimum three years’ EHR/IT Experience in a support or operations environment.
* OCHIN certification/proficiency required.
* EpicCare Ambulatory Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Epic Prelude Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Epic Cadence Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Experience with vendor management or vendor collaboration preferred.

  

Behavioral Competencies:
  

Accountability: Role model VG’s mission, vision, and shared values
  

Customer\-Focus: Listen to the voice of the customer and strive to delight them by exceeding their expectations
  

Teamwork: If someone needs help, help them
  

Initiative: Be innovative, apply fresh ideas, and continuously improve how you do your work
  

Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality and respect the privacy of others
  

Ethical: Demonstrate integrity, honesty, and stewardship in all encounters at work
  

Respect: Demonstrate consideration and appreciation for co\-workers and patients
  

Communication: Demonstrate the ability to convey thoughts and ideas as well as understand perspective of others
  

  

Physical Requirements:
   

Percentage of time spent
  

* Computer use: up to 90%
* Standing/Walking: up to 30%
* Sitting: up to 90%
* Lifting/Carrying: less than 5%; may occasionally lift up to 20 lbs.
* Travel to multiple locations within Washington and Yamhill counties and working flexible hours.

  

Working Environment:
  

* Work in well\-lighted and ventilated environments.
* Potential exposure to blood borne pathogens and hazardous chemicals.

Office equipment Used:
  

* Computer
* Telephone, fax, copier, scanner, printer

  

Immunization:
  

Staff members must meet immunization requirements as stated in VGMHC’s immunization policy and state and federal guidelines.
Job descriptions represent a general outline of the essential and major job duties, functions and qualifications required. They cannot be all\-inclusive and comprehensive due to the dynamic nature of work performed to accomplish VGMHC’s Mission.


VGMHC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. No person is unlawfully excluded from consideration for employment because of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, veteran status, marital status, or physical challenges. The policy applies not only to recruitment and hiring practices, but also includes fairness in placement, promotion, transfer, rate of pay, and termination.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, EHR & PMS Integrations
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
================


Liine is a fast\-growing software startup based in downtown Raleigh, NC. Our AI\-powered call tracking, marketing analytics and ad optimization platform helps specialty healthcare and dental practices convert more new patient inquiries into appointments. With over $10M in ARR and winner of the 2026 Triangle Business Journal's 50 Best Places to Work, we are on our way to making Liine a core component of every healthcare practice's technology stack.

  

More about Liine (click links to view)


Read our case studies


Read our customer reviews


Startups in Raleigh You Need to Know in 2025


19 Raleigh Startups Making the City a Top Tech Destination


Liine named as a Call Recording FrontRunner by SoftwareAdvice


Liine named to Capterra's Shortlist for Call Recording


Liine named an AI "Category Leader" by GetApp


Liine Glassdoor Reviews

**About the team:**
-------------------


You will be joining our Healthcare Data Integrations team to help build how patient, appointment, and revenue data gets into Liine. Team responsibilities include:

**Direct EHR/PMS integrations** — designing and standing up direct connections to systems like ModMed, NextGen, Open Dental, WinOMS/Carestream, and others.

**Bespoke MROI audits and ingestion** — profiling raw sample data from partner data sources, proving feasibility, and building the ingestion that powers MROI reporting.

**Aggregator program management** — project\-managing integrations that run through third\-party data aggregators, and holding those partners accountable to data quality standards.

**Build vs. buy evaluation** — assessing integration decisions over time based on data quality, cost, and control considerations.

  

This is a relatively new mandate at Liine, so the team has unusual room to shape its own tooling, standards, and playbooks.

  

**The role:**
-------------


As the team's Data Scientist, you are the person who looks at a brand\-new pile of healthcare data and figures out whether — and how — it can be trusted to drive revenue reporting. You will sit at the intersection of raw vendor data and the Liine MROI product, profiling incoming data, diagnosing quality problems, defining the mappings and transformations that normalize it, and validating that what lands in our dashboards is correct.

  

You will work hands\-on every day in SQL and Python, partner closely with the Integration Software Engineer who builds the production pipelines, and act as Liine's technical counterpart


to the data analysts and engineers on the vendor and aggregator side. This is a deep individual contributor role for someone who is energized by messy, real\-world healthcare data and takes pride in getting it right.

  

Our top priorities for this role are data accuracy and security. You will be working with data used to drive millions of dollars of decisions — accuracy and transparency are essential. You will also be handling data protected under HIPAA, which must always be kept private and secure. Security is not an afterthought at Liine, and all candidates should seriously consider the


responsibility that comes with this role.

  

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* **Audit new data sources for MROI readiness.** Profile EHR, PMS, and partner data\-lake exports for completeness, key coverage, linkage, and revenue\-reporting feasibility, then deliver a clear go / conditional\-go / no\-go recommendation.
* **Diagnose and resolve data\-quality blockers.** Identify the specific issues that break reporting, such as missing encounter IDs, incomplete charge fields, weak patient matching, or absent creation dates, and convert them into precise requests for vendors or aggregators.
* **Define normalization and mapping logic.** Map vendor schemas to Liine's data model and design transformations such as collapsing inconsistent, EMR\-specific appointment statuses into stable FHIR\-style buckets that hold up across many source systems.
* **Partner on production ingestion.** Work with the Integration Software Engineer to turn validated mappings into repeatable pipelines, including file\-based and data\-lake handoffs.
* **Own ongoing data quality.** Build monitoring, reconciliation, and drift\-detection checks that keep MROI reporting accurate after go\-live.
* **Build the team's tooling and standards.** Help turn repeated audit work into reusable tooling, templates, and eventually more automated auditing, so each successive integration is faster than the last.
* **Support build vs. buy decisions.** Help assess integration options as the program scales, weighing data quality, cost, and control against partnership and aggregator alternatives.

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

* **5–7 years with production data.** You have worked in data science, data engineering, data quality, or analytics engineering roles where imperfect real\-world data directly affects business decisions.
* **Strong SQL and Python.** You are fluent in SQL and comfortable using Python, including pandas or equivalent tools, for profiling, validation, and transformation work every day.
* **Healthcare data\-quality judgment.** You can reason about null rates, key coverage, record linkage, and downstream reporting risk, especially in patient, appointment, encounter, and charge data.
* **Comfort with relational data modeling.** You understand entity relationships and joins deeply and can reason about how dimensions and facts (patients, appointments, encounters, charges) should link.
* **ETL and ingestion experience.** You have built or closely supported pipelines involving file\-based, warehouse, or data\-lake handoffs such as CSV, S3, Snowflake, or similar systems.
* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can explain a data problem precisely enough that a vendor's engineer knows exactly what to fix and summarize an audit so a product leader can make a call.
* **Ownership and rigor.** You are comfortable being accountable for whether the numbers are right and communicating issues clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Experience with healthcare data — EHR/PMS systems, clinical or claims/charge data, or FHIR\-based models.
* Familiarity with specific systems in our world: ModMed, NextGen, Open Dental, WinOMS / Carestream, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, or Athena.
* Experience working through healthcare data aggregators or middleware platforms.
* Working knowledge of PHI/HIPAA handling, BAAs, and secure data exchange.
* Snowflake and AWS (S3, IAM) familiarity, including storage\-integration patterns between a partner's warehouse and your buckets.
* Exposure to marketing\-attribution or revenue/ROI analytics.
* Interest in building internal tooling and pushing toward more automated, repeatable data audits.

**How you'll work:**
--------------------


You will report to the Healthcare Data Integrations Team Lead and work in close, day\-to\-day partnership with the team's Integration Software Engineer. The role also carries a strong dotted\-line relationship to Liine's Director of Engineering, who sets technical standards and helps guide the more architectural calls. You will collaborate regularly with Product, Implementation, and Customer Operations, and you will be Liine's hands\-on technical point of contact with our integration and aggregator partners.

  

**Perks and benefits include:**
-------------------------------

* Competitive base salary
* Generous equity package
* 4% 401K contribution match
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Short and long\-term disability insurance
* Unlimited PTO

**Additional Information:**
---------------------------


Candidates who can work out of our downtown Raleigh office are preferred, but we will also consider exceptional remote applications. We work from our downtown Raleigh office on


Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with the option to work remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

  

We’re building something special and are looking for great people to join our team!

In addition, ECAM complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment including, but not limited to hiring, placement, assignment, promotion, termination, layoffs, recalls, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. jobs.title: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

**Organization:** Facilitron Inc

**About Us:** Facilitron is a funded, fast\-growing (\#30 in the Financial Times \- America's Fastest Growing Companies in 2021\) startup who partners with schools, colleges and municipalities across the United States to simplify the scheduling and maintenance of public spaces. With over 7\-billion square feet of gyms, athletic fields, auditoriums, classrooms and more available to the public for rent, Facilitron is the leading marketplace for public space rentals. Today, thousands of schools and other public and private facility owners partner with Facilitron to rent and manage their real estate assets.

**Type of work:** Remote

**Salary**: $45K\-$65K based on experience.

**Position**: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist

We are seeking a **Works Implementation Solutions Specialist** to assist our clients through onboarding, technical enablement, and ongoing daily operations. In this role, you will provide hands\-on, high\-touch support to ensure smooth rollouts and stable long\-term platform use.

A background in **Maintenance \& Operations (M\&O)**—ideally with prior experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operational coordinator capacity—is required to understand our clients' physical/operational workflows and maintenance environments. **Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish** is strongly preferred to support our growing multi\-regional account base.

**Key Responsibilities Implementation \& Client Onboarding**

* Support end\-to\-end client implementations, helping configure systems, map workflows, and execute rollout plans under the guidance of project managers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for operational queries and technical onboarding assistance during the client go\-live phase.
* Deliver bilingual (English/Spanish) training sessions and step\-by\-step documentation to client end\-users and maintenance teams.

**Operational \& Account Support**

* Leverage M\&O experience to understand client workflows, troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, and maintain system readiness.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve daily technical support tickets, escalations, and system configuration requests.
* Monitor account health, track recurring support patterns, and assist in maintaining high service\-level agreements (SLAs).

jobs.description:
Do you want to join a company that:

* has been voted a **Top Workplace in the Madison, WI** **area** for the *seventh* year in a row?
* is a family\-based company that values a work\-life balance?
* has quarterly in\-office chair massages available at no cost to its team members?
* has implemented solar panels to help reduce its carbon footprint?

At **Amtelco**, we believe in the importance of individuals, the diversity they bring, and the power of teamwork. We listen to our team members and select initiatives that are important to them. Join our family\-owned business where we value work\-life balance and create a fun, supportive, inclusive environment for our team members to succeed in!

**Amtelco** is the leader in developing SQL\-based applications that are an open platform for critical interoperability in Healthcare and Commercial markets throughout the United States. We have received more than 30 U.S. Patents for telephony software, data handling methodologies, and telephone switching devices!

We’re actively seeking an **Implementation Specialist** in our Implementation department that will contribute to our mission of working with our family of customers to provide the very best products and support, creating a successful long\-term partnership.

The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for training on the configuration and maintenance of 10\+ platforms / applications / interfaces offered by Amtelco. The Implementation Specialist is testing new software and is learning about existing software. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include training our customers to process calls and to complete coding proprietary to Amtelco software, creating site\-specific documentation, developing reference materials and movies for Amtelco’s TechHelper website, assisting our many customers in various ways through phone and e\-mail interactions as well as on\-site visits, and developing or enhancing processes and procedures that make the department more efficient. Additionally, this position works closely with our Implementation Specialist Team Leads, Senior Implementation Specialists, and the Project Management Team.

This full\-time position is based at **Amtelco’s** corporate headquarters in McFarland, WI and reports to our Implementation Team Director.

**How will I make an impact?**

* Work with the Implementation Team, other team members, and independently to learn new software \& its best practice rollout to customers and implement existing software better
* Educate customers on programming features associated with and on the operational use of software upgrades and new installations
* Lead agent training and more basic project training sessions remotely
* Document project training sessions
* Create custom documentation for call processing and programming
* Suggest call processing, telephony programming, and script flow improvements for individual customer sites
* Assist operators on cutovers
* Respond to and validate customer concerns and reach out for proper follow\-up
* Provide the Implementation Specialist Team Lead with project updates and concerns, completing project steps in a timely manner
* Troubleshoot software bugs with the Implementation Specialist Team Lead and Senior Implementation Specialist, including the installation of new software
* Advocate for streamlined programming enhancements and future software development to the Team Lead
* Assist Senior Implementation Specialists with template design content for uptraining new Implementation Specialists and customers
* Attend and actively participate in team and implementation meetings
* Provide post\-cut support on reports, dashboards, and data maintenance routines
* Reply to customer emails from a shared inbox and follow proper delivery protocol
* Become an expert in specific areas of software including Amtelco’s secure messaging platform
* Present at conferences in Madison, WI and perhaps other locations nationally

**What does success look like in this role?**

* Bachelor’s degree *preferred*; associate degree *required*
* Experience in answering service and/or hospital environments *preferred*
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access
* Familiarity with Camtasia *preferred*
* Technical proficiencies
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and multi\-tasking abilities
* Excellent communication and customer\-service skills
* Reliable with a professional attitude
* Ability to **travel** throughout North America **up to 25%** of the time ***required***
